title: Khoon-e-Hussain Chaadar-e-Zainab ki Daastan
body:
Ya Mustafa Ridaen Bhi Ummat Nai Cheenli (x2)
Ab Ja Kai Sir Chupaa Ai Teri Betiyaan Kahaan (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Washat Say Qatl Gahhmai Chonkay Garaat Bhar (x2)
Asgher Ko Jungalo Mai Pukaaray Gi Maa Kahaan (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Kai Baazvon Mai Rasan Kya Andhair Hain (x2)
Abbas Bawafa Ali Akbar Jawaan Kahaan (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad-e-Hussain Soyi Sakina Na Chain Sai (x2)
Bhoolay Kai Baazvon Mai Bandhi Raismaan Kahaan (x2)
